#1 — OpenAI Previews GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna Models with Focus on Agentic Workflows — OpenAI Release Notes / Releasebot

★ GPT-5.6 Sol is built for frontier reasoning and long-horizon agentic work, advancing coding, scientific reasoning, long-horizon planning, and agentic workflows—directly addressing your core focus on agentic workflows and enterprise AI operating models.

OpenAI previewed GPT-5.6 Sol alongside Terra and Luna, with Sol designed for frontier reasoning and agentic work, advancing coding, scientific reasoning, and long-horizon planning. The company also introduced GeneBench-Pro, a research-level benchmark for judging AI agents in computational biology with harder synthetic tasks and strong model results on scientific reasoning under uncertainty.
